prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. ONE extraordinarily intimate, beautiful, photorealistic food-and-packaging concept photograph for a future Korean microwave rice product, vertical 4:5 width:height 0.8, ideally 1600x2000. No lettering, no logos or typography anywhere. This is an original photograph of an imagined future product, not a collage.

The idea: a loved one's simple little drawing is revealed by CONDENSATION on the inside of the rice tray's transparent lid, only when the rice is heated. Warm food becomes a personal message. The drawing is neither printed ink nor a screen, hologram, projected light or floating steam sculpture: it is physically made of tiny WATER DROPLETS / clear anti-fog strokes on the transparent film. This precise material effect must be the instantly interesting focal point.

Composition: macro editorial food photography, close but comprehensible, looking gently downward at a normal-sized SHALLOW round white ribbed instant-rice tray on a small dark warm walnut table. The tray fills approx 65% of image width in the LOWER HALF, fully in frame. Beautiful fresh cooked Korean short-grain white rice, naturally slightly elongated irregular plump grains, translucent moist gloss, soft real warmth; not pearl pellets. The lid is transparent thin food film with a tiny clean white sealing rim, gently peeled upward and backward in ONE smooth curved sheet by the dry pull tab in a single realistic adult hand entering from right. The hand is clean, warm and anatomically correct; thumb and index pinch the OUTSIDE tab, no fingers in food. The film is still attached across the back arc of the bowl and rises over the bowl like a small curved translucent page. It is film, not a solid glass dome, not a huge wrapper.

The film's central visible area is a luminous pearl-grey patch of natural fine condensation, surrounded by clear unfogged film. In this fog patch, clean slightly irregular hand-drawn lines appear as CLEAR STROKES THROUGH THE FOG: an original, simple little childlike drawing of TWO STICK FIGURES HOLDING HANDS, with ONE small heart between/above them and a tiny smiling sun at the side. The drawing is large enough to instantly recognize on a phone, about 35% of image width, gently following the film curvature. Not words, not symbols from any franchise. The transparent clear linework lets the rice or warm scene behind be seen; edges are made of natural tiny droplets, highlights and surface tension. The rest of the film retains convincing beads of water, a few gathered droplets and gentle plastic crinkles. The drawing has emerged WITHIN the fog of the film, not painted in white, not engraved on rice. Make the warm personal message striking but entirely plausible as a conceptual moisture-responsive film.

A very small edge of one side-dish plate and a spoon can remain at lower left, quieter than the rice, not a food banquet. Background is a softly blurred, ordinary intimate home at early evening, deep desaturated petrol/charcoal with one warm amber lamp bokeh far right. No faces, no portrait photos, no phone screens, no futuristic furniture. Emotion is a sudden small surprise, tender connection and delicious warm food, not grief or a deceased relative. This is a living person's friendly drawing, not a memorial.

Lighting: exquisitely controlled warm back/side light through the curved condensation film makes the water droplets sparkle delicately and separates the rice, the clear line drawing and the deep blue-black background. Gentle natural ivory skin highlights and rich walnut shadows. Avoid heavy orange cast, excessive glow, glitter, smoke or ghostly vapour. The real steam is subtle and remains close to the rice, never forming characters.

Leave the TOP 25% predominantly deep calm charcoal/petrol negative space for an official logo and two-line headline to be added later. Upper left completely uncluttered. The hand and condensation drawing start BELOW this headline zone. Allow a dark unobtrusive lower margin for a short future-product disclaimer. Premium emotionally specific advertising photograph, impeccable optics, restrained art direction, highly detailed truthful food texture.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, screens, holograms, floating figures, faces, extra hands or extra fingers. ONE 4:5 photograph.

Correct the MATERIAL OF THE DRAWING on the lid in this photo, while preserving the beautiful food, hand, bowl, intimate dark background, warm light, 4:5 composition and empty upper-left headline area.
The current grey-brown stick figures look like printed marker INK. That is WRONG. Remove ALL pigment. Recreate the SAME pair holding hands, small heart and sun as TRANSPARENT ANTI-FOG STROKES in a fogged film, exactly like a finger has wiped a drawing through condensation on a window.

Physical appearance requirements: the large surrounding patch is translucent finely FROSTED by countless tiny water droplets. Each drawing stroke is a 4-6mm wide CLEAR, DEW-FREE PATH THROUGH THAT FROST. Its color is NOT uniform: the clear paths reveal the actual background behind the curved film, blue-black in the upper parts and warm honey-gold or rice-white in the lower parts, depending on what lies behind them. On the edges of each clear stroke, fine beads gather naturally into uneven sparkling menisci. There are ZERO opaque dark outlines and ZERO white painted outlines. The drawing is legible through contrast between the clear line paths and the diffused grey fog. Preserve the simple charming original doodle, but make it unmistakably moisture/fog, not a sticker, ink print, laser etching or digital projection. No floating steam drawings.

One supporting detail to establish this is a PERSONAL drawing: replace the cut-off side dish plate and spoon at the lower left with a SMALL casually folded ivory paper card lying next to the rice bowl, about 14% of image width. On that card is the SAME pair of stick figures, heart and little sun, drawn simply in soft rusty red pencil; no words or lettering. The card remains a secondary foreground detail, not a second poster panel. It must look like the source drawing that is now revealed in the warm fogged lid, without any phone UI or extra technology. This is an original fictional doodle, not any known character. Match the source picture and the condensation drawing's poses.

Keep the rice tray shallow and food delicious, plausible slightly elongated cooked short-grain rice, warm not orange. Keep the single thumb/index cleanly holding only the dry outside pull tab, no extra hands. The film is THIN flexible transparent plastic, not a heavy glass cloche. Keep warm fine droplets on the film but no water pouring into rice, dirty grime or wet-looking packaging debris. Do not alter the upper 25% empty dark charcoal area. No logos, text, numbers or watermarks. ONE photorealistic 4:5 image.

One surgical material correction to the drawing on the lid ONLY. Keep the 4:5 photograph, rice, bowl, hand, warm lighting, source paper drawing bottom left and clean dark top quarter exactly unchanged.

The pair holding hands, heart and sun currently look like dark printed line art. REPLACE THOSE DARK LINES with visible physically TRANSPARENT WATER BEADS AND COALESCED LIQUID DROPLETS gathered in the same line shapes on the film. Think of the drawing as a delicate raised miniature water sculpture stuck to the film surface, made entirely of clear water, created by selective condensation. NOT negative engraved lines, NOT grey marker ink, NOT brown pigment.

Each stroke is formed of tiny 1-3mm CLEAR convex droplet beads that merge into short rounded liquid segments. At each edge there are bright wet meniscus highlights, occasional tiny inverted refracted glimpses of the amber room, and transparent blue-black centers. The bead sizes vary organically; they are NOT metallic studs, crystals, pearls, glue or sequins. Make the water-drawn figures and heart legible and luminous by back/side-light glints, but no artificial glow. The thin fogged film behind is quieter so the water linework is visibly distinct from it. Do not simply draw a dark silhouette surrounded by sparkles. Every part of the outline must read as actual clear WATER VOLUME, with enough bright/translucent changes to stop it reading as ink. The main large heart can be a continuous, clear convex liquid ridge with delicate highlights, with the figures formed of smaller coalesced droplets. These droplets are physically attached to the FILM, not floating in air or dripping into food.

The small paper card stays rusty-red pencil, proving the original sketch and the moisture-revealed version are two different media of the SAME drawing. Preserve those shapes/poses but make material difference instantly apparent. This is an imagined future food-film material, not an actually demonstrated mechanism. No text/logos/watermarks. No additional objects or changes to composition. Keep food mouthwatering and hand outside food.
